summary: The HSPnetPage system is designed for managing user sessions, handling errors and warnings, and providing a consistent user interface across the application. It incorporates session timeout mechanisms, error handling, and includes scripts for enhancing user interface interactions. The page setup includes adding stylesheets and JavaScript for session management and Google Analytics.
purpose: The purpose of the HSPnetPage is to provide a structured approach to handling sessions, user interface elements, and integrated functionalities such as Google Analytics tracking within the HSPnet framework.
business_rules: If TimeOutSecond is less than TimeOutWarningSeconds, timeout defaults to 1800 seconds.
validations: Validate URL Hash for certain pages.
Session must be valid to avoid redirection.
calculations: Calculate remaining session time in seconds.
conditions: Check if session is valid; if not, redirect to Timedout.aspx.
If the session is switched for viewing only, append read-only monitoring note.
system_behavior: Load and apply culture settings based on session or URL query.
Clear intervals using a Set to manage running intervals.
Display session timeout warnings using dialogs.
dependencies: Resources for localization and text content
ConfigurationManager for retrieving Google Analytics ID.
exceptions: If no valid locale is found, use the default locale.
